Passing live check: PutJobSuccessResult with job ID

items.text:
The supplied Lambda action follows deployment and checks the supplied endpoint. Its job-result call uses the job_id below and occurs after the shown response comparison.
```text
job_id: "smoke-0"
revision: "exercise-revision"
endpoint: "exercise-service-endpoint"
deployment_status: "completed"
expected_response: "Supplied expected response for exercise-revision"
observed_response: "does not match"
job_result_call: "PutJobFailureResult"
dependent_progression: "blocked"
```

The supplied Lambda action follows deployment and checks the supplied endpoint. Its job-result call uses the job_id below and occurs after the shown response comparison.
```text
job_id: "smoke-1"
revision: "exercise-revision"
endpoint: "exercise-service-endpoint"
deployment_status: "completed"
expected_response: "Supplied expected response for exercise-revision"
observed_response: "matches"
job_result_call: "PutJobSuccessResult"
dependent_progression: "permitted by this gate"
```
Alternate implementation: deployment completed; the endpoint response does not match the expected deployed-revision response; action nevertheless calls PutJobSuccessResult.

item1.message: Judgement: Failing live check: PutJobFailureResult and blocked progression. Compare the stated evidence with the required criterion.

item2.message: Judgement: Passing live check: PutJobSuccessResult with job ID. Compare the stated evidence with the required criterion.

review1.message: Judgement: Incorrect success reporting. Compare the stated evidence with the required criterion.

correct.message: Correct. Your judgement follows the supplied evidence and the stated requirement.

incorrect.message: Compare the evidence with the requirement rather than inferring success from a partial signal. The action checks the supplied endpoint against the expected response for the deployed revision. A passing check calls PutJobSuccessResult with the job ID; a failing check calls PutJobFailureResult and leaves dependent progression blocked.

hints: Separate the observed outcome from what was merely intended.
Check every required condition, not just the most reassuring field.
